function.name: get_weather
function.description: Gets the weather data for a chosen location

param1.description: Name of the place you want to get the weather for

function.name: get_location_info
function.description:
Looks up geographic metadata for a place by name. Returns coordinates, timezone, country, county, municipality, elevation, population, and feature type.

Use when the user asks about a specific location's details, coordinates, or geographic context.
Do NOT use for weather, directions, or if the location is already in context.

Parameters:
- place_name (required): the name of the place to look up

param1.description: Name of the place you want to get the data about
